lines: Your agent forgets past sessions, wasting time repeating work instead of building on history.
Claude-Mem captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions.
Claude uses MCP tools to search your memory first, then it fetches full details only for the filtered IDs.
Install with npx claude-mem install for Grok Bot to watch its chat log files since it lacks standard hooks.
It offers up to 100 more usage time after signing in for free.
It also supports OpenClaw gateways and sets up dependencies automatically with a single command.
Alex Newman built it under Apache License 2.0 with 96,979 GitHub stars.
Save this for a developer facing agent memory limits today.
Stop wasting tokens on forgotten history with claude-mem.
